title: Fix `edit this page` link for reference API
body:
This patch fixes the edit this page link. The problem was linked to the environment used and the assumptions that the folder of the project would be `instantsearch.js`. Now we use a more generic solution.

This patch also move the destination of the link to develop to avoid duplicate contributions.
